sloka: ततो मरुत्तं नृपतिं यजन्तं सह दैवतैः ।उशीरबीजमासाद्य ददर्श स तु रावणः ।। ७.१८.२ ॥
transliteration: tato maruttaṁ nṛpatiṁ yajantaṁ saha daivataiḥ ।uśīrabījamāsādya dadarśa sa tu rāvaṇaḥ ।। 7.18.2 ॥

translations.english: Then, having arrived at Ushirabija, Ravana saw King Marutta performing a sacrifice with the deities.
